description: NiO AFM-II, SCAN0r: orbital-tau SCAN exchange and correlation everywhere (TYPE='SCAN', TSCANDELOC=T) plus 25% onsite exact exchange on Ni and O, double counting with the same TSCAN exchange (no DCTYPE override). Added 2026-10-03; DAV, RMM and friction MD must agree. The route-1 stall (2026-10-03) was a Hamiltonian that was not the derivative of the energy: the frozen-core tau potential was subtracted from the valence tau potential of the TSCAN double counting; fixed 2026-10-10 and RMM and friction MD added back.
